questions.answer: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
accepted_answers: For underprivileged students living in remote villages, free Internet service provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
To disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access offered by the government often matters more than a new computer.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（provided by …）

questions.stem: 然而，這種網路速度常常很慢，這讓學生很難下載老師在網路上分享的數位教材。
questions.answer: However, such Internet access is often slow, which makes it hard for students to download the digital materials their teachers share online.
accepted_answers: However, this kind of Internet access is often very slow, which makes it difficult for students to download the digital teaching materials that their teachers share online.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which makes it …）
關係代名詞子句（省略受格關代）

1.explanation_zh: 「對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說」寫 For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas；「弱勢」是處境不利，用 disadvantaged，不是 weak。「由政府提供的免費網路」修飾語很長，英文把它放到名詞後面，用過去分詞片語 free Internet access provided by the government（網路是被提供的，用 p.p.）。「比一台新電腦更重要」用比較級 is more important than a new computer，computer 是可數名詞，單數要加 a；「往往」often 放在 be 動詞後面。
evidence: 由政府提供的免費網路
1.strategy_zh: 看到「由…＋動詞＋的＋名詞」，先想「名詞＋過去分詞＋by …」的後位修飾；「比…更＋形容詞」用 more + adj. + than。
hints: 切成四段：對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說／由政府提供的／免費網路／往往比一台新電腦更重要
標的詞彙：disadvantaged（弱勢的）、remote（偏遠的）、rural（鄉村的）、student（學生）、provide（提供）、government（政府）、free（免費的）、Internet（網路）、important（重要的）、computer（電腦）
句型框架：For + N, N + p.p. + by … + is often more + adj. + than + N.

2.explanation_zh: 「這種網路速度常常很慢」可寫 this kind of Internet access is often slow（或 the speed of … is often slow），be 動詞後接形容詞 slow。「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which makes it hard for students to …；不能寫成 makes students hard to …。「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」是英文的關係子句 the digital materials (that) their teachers share online，materials 是 share 的受詞，關代可以省略，但子句裡不能再加 them。
evidence: 老師在網路上分享的數位教材
2.strategy_zh: 「…，這讓…」指前面整件事時用 , which …；「讓某人很難…」固定寫成 make it hard for sb to VR。
hints: 切成四段：然而，這種網路速度常常很慢／這讓／學生很難下載／老師在網路上分享的數位教材
標的詞彙：Internet（網路）、slow（慢的）、hard（困難的）、student（學生）、download（下載）、digital（數位的）、material（教材）、teacher（老師）、share（分享）、online（在網路上）
句型框架：However, S + is often slow, which makes it hard for + O + to VR + N + (that) + S + V.

traps.zh: 由政府提供的免費網路
traps.literal_error: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, the government providing free Internet is often more important than a new computer.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「由政府提供的」放在名詞前，英文要改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：free Internet access provided by the government；寫成 the government providing … 主詞變成政府，意思也不對。

bonus.text: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, nothing matters more than free Internet access provided by the government, not even a brand-new computer.
bonus.explanation_zh: nothing matters more than …（沒有什麼比…更重要）用否定＋比較級表最高級，not even 補充強調；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「由政府提供的免費網路」中文的修飾語在名詞前，英文改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：free Internet access provided by the government。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「對…來說」For（To）＋disadvantaged／underprivileged students（students from disadvantaged／low-income families）＋in／living in／who live in＋remote rural areas（remote villages）；「由政府提供的」provided／offered／supplied by the government，寫成完整的關係子句 that／which is provided by the government 或 that the government provides 也算達成本句 PART（後位修飾）標的；「免費網路」free Internet (access／service／connection)、free Wi-Fi；「往往」often／usually／frequently；「比一台新電腦更重要」is more important than a new computer（than new computers、than having a new computer 也可以），matters more than a new computer 也給分。另外也給分：students from poor families、the remote countryside、remote rural regions、a brand-new computer、a new laptop、counts for more than。

traps.literal_error: However, such Internet access is often slow, it makes it hard for students to download the digital materials their teachers share online.
traps.explanation_zh: 「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事；英文逗號後不能再接一個完整句子 it makes …，要用非限定關係子句 , which makes …。

traps.literal_error: …which makes students hard to download the digital materials their teachers share online.
traps.explanation_zh: 「讓某人很難做某事」是 make it hard for sb to VR；hard 不能直接修飾 students。

bonus.text: So slow is this kind of Internet access that students can barely download the digital materials their teachers share online.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adj. + is + S + that … 是倒裝的「如此…以致於…」，can barely（幾乎無法）加強語氣。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這讓學生很難…」不能寫成 makes students hard to …，要用 make it hard for students to …；「這讓」指前面整件事，用 , which …。「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」改成後位的關係子句 the digital materials (that) their teachers share online。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「這種網路」this kind of／this type of／such／this (free) Internet access（service、connection）；「速度常常很慢」is often (very) slow，寫 the speed of … is often (very) slow／low 也可以；「這讓」用 , which makes it …（which 指前面整件事），寫成句尾分詞 , making it hard … 意思相同，也算達成本句 NRREL 標的；「很難下載」hard／difficult for students to download；「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」the digital (teaching／learning) materials（digital textbooks 也可以）+ (that／which) their teachers share／post／upload online（on the Internet），關代可以省略；寫成 the digital materials shared online by their teachers（關係子句的省略形）也算達成本句 REL 標的。另外也給分：主詞寫 the connection／the Internet connection／the Internet speed／its speed／the connection speed + is often (very) slow／low；the digital materials posted／uploaded online by their teachers。

1.translation: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
1.explanation_zh: 「由政府提供的」用過去分詞片語 provided by the government 後位修飾；「比…更重要」用 more important than；「弱勢學生」譯 disadvantaged students。

2.translation: However, such Internet connections are often very slow, which makes it difficult for students to download the digital teaching materials that their teachers share online.
2.explanation_zh: 「網路速度很慢」英文以 connection is slow 表達較自然；「這讓學生很難…」用非限定關係子句 , which makes it difficult for … to V；「老師在網路上分享的」用 that 關係子句，share online 用現在式表習慣。

issues_zh: references[2]「the speed of this Internet service is often very slow」：speed 習慣用 low／high 形容，speed is slow 是常被糾正的搭配；建議改 is often very low，或改以網路服務當主詞 this Internet service is often very slow；notes_zh 的「slow／low」也建議只留 low。

4 部分切法本身公平；但 parts[0].accepted 沒有收複數寫法「However, such Internet connections are often (very) slow」（notes_zh 已列 such … connection，只差單複數），本盲譯就是這個寫法，建議補進 accepted（such Internet connections／such Internet services + are often (very) slow）。

1.translation: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
1.explanation_zh: 「對……來說」用 For ...,；「由政府提供的」用過去分詞片語 provided by the government 後置修飾；「比一台新電腦更重要」用 more important than a new computer，「往往」用 often。

2.translation: However, this kind of Internet connection is often slow, which makes it difficult for students to download the digital materials that teachers share online.
2.explanation_zh: 「這讓學生很難……」用非限定關係子句 which makes it difficult for students to ...（it 為虛受詞）；「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」用 that 子句修飾 digital materials；「這種網路」指前一句政府提供的網路，譯為 this kind of Internet connection。

status_reason: 判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：record_verification 判 verified，但判定改為退回，評分規準有實質錯誤。①第 2 題第 1 部分「然而，這種網路速度常常很慢」的 accepted 把 slow 機械替換成 low，收了 such Internet access is often low、this Internet service is often very low、the Internet connection is often low、the connection is often very low、this Internet is often low 共 28 種錯誤寫法（low 只能形容 speed，不能拿來形容 Internet、connection、service、access 本身），標的詞 slow 的 alternatives 也收了 low，學生寫錯也拿滿分。②第 2 題第 2、3 部分有跨部分依賴：第 2 部分「這讓」收了單獨的 which makes（只能搭配第 3 部分的 students unable to download），第 3 部分收了 hard for students to download（只能搭配 which makes it），逐部分給分時漏掉虛受詞 it 的 which makes hard for students to download 會拿滿分，而這正是本題 make it hard for sb to VR 的典型錯誤，common_errors 沒有列。修正需要改評分規準（刪掉以 Internet／connection／service／access 為主詞的 low 寫法、slow 的 alternatives 拿掉 low；第 2 部分拿掉單獨的 which makes，或把 which makes students unable to download … 整句收進 references；common_errors 補 which makes hard for students to …），超出判定者只能改註解小錯的權限。另：驗證者 A 指出參考譯文 3 與 accepted 的 the speed of … is (very) slow，speed 較道地的搭配是 low／high，重生時可一併調整（這點本身不構成退回理由）。第 1 題沒有問題。
